source_text: Qui purus mente orationes et gratiarum actiones fundit, per angelum altaris primitias immolationis suae pontifici magno Christo obtulit, cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Who pure in-mind prayers and of-thanks actions pours, through angel of-altar firstfruits of-sacrifice his to-high-priest great Christ offered, to-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Whoever with a pure mind pours out prayers and thanksgivings has, through the angel of the altar, offered the firstfruits of his sacrifice to the great High Priest, Christ Jesus, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
